# Ocean Coast Recovery Center

> Ocean Coast Recovery Center is an intimate, six-bed residential drug and alcohol rehab in Costa Mesa, California, offering medical detox, residential treatment, dual diagnosis care, family therapy and lifelong aftercare.

Address: 1799 Hummingbird Drive, Costa Mesa, CA 92626. Admissions phone: (949) 649-0702, available 24/7. Email: info@oceancoastrecovery.com. Licensed by the California Department of Health Care Services (DHCS License #300423AP).

Content on this site is general information, not medical advice. In an emergency call 911; for a mental health or substance use crisis, call or text 988.

## Treatment programs

- [Addiction Treatment Services in Orange County](https://www.oceancoastrecovery.com/treatment/): Comprehensive drug & alcohol treatment in Costa Mesa, CA — medical detox, residential inpatient, dual diagnosis, family therapy, and aftercare.
- [Aftercare & Alumni Program in Orange County](https://www.oceancoastrecovery.com/treatment/aftercare/): Recovery doesn't end at discharge. Ocean Coast Recovery's aftercare and alumni program in Orange County provides relapse prevention, connection, and lifelong support.
- [Drug & Alcohol Detox Center in Costa Mesa, CA](https://www.oceancoastrecovery.com/treatment/detox/): Safe, medically supervised detox in Costa Mesa with 24/7 clinical monitoring, medication-assisted comfort, and a seamless transition to residential care.
- [Dual Diagnosis Treatment in Costa Mesa, CA](https://www.oceancoastrecovery.com/treatment/dual-diagnosis/): Integrated dual diagnosis care in Costa Mesa treating addiction and co-occurring mental health disorders together — depression, anxiety, PTSD, bipolar, and more.
- [Family Therapy for Addiction in Orange County](https://www.oceancoastrecovery.com/treatment/family-therapy/): Addiction is a family disease. Ocean Coast Recovery's family therapy program helps loved ones heal, set healthy boundaries, and support lasting recovery together.
- [Luxury Residential Inpatient Rehab in Costa Mesa, CA](https://www.oceancoastrecovery.com/treatment/residential/): Immersive, 24/7 residential addiction treatment in an intimate six-bed home in Costa Mesa. 30, 60, and 90+ day options with evidence-based, personalized care.

## Who we help

- [Who We Help](https://www.oceancoastrecovery.com/who-we-help/): Specialized, population-specific addiction treatment in Costa Mesa, CA — for young adults, college students, professionals, first responders, the LGBTQ+ community, men, and women.
- [College Students](https://www.oceancoastrecovery.com/who-we-help/college-students/): Inpatient drug & alcohol rehab for college students in Costa Mesa, CA — treatment that fits around the semester with relapse-prevention planning for campus life.
- [First Responders](https://www.oceancoastrecovery.com/who-we-help/first-responders/): Trauma-informed addiction treatment for first responders in Costa Mesa, CA — detox and inpatient care with peer-aware support for police, fire, and EMS.
- [LGBTQ+ Community](https://www.oceancoastrecovery.com/who-we-help/lgbtq/): LGBTQ+ affirming drug & alcohol rehab in Costa Mesa, CA — specialized, safe, dual-diagnosis care that honors your identity and lived experience.
- [Men](https://www.oceancoastrecovery.com/who-we-help/men/): Men's addiction treatment in Costa Mesa, CA — gender-specific groups and evidence-based care that create a safe space for men to heal.
- [Professionals](https://www.oceancoastrecovery.com/who-we-help/professionals/): Discreet, executive-friendly addiction treatment for professionals in Costa Mesa, CA — private care with work-life boundary support in an intimate six-bed setting.
- [Women](https://www.oceancoastrecovery.com/who-we-help/women/): Women's addiction treatment in Costa Mesa, CA — women-only groups and dual-diagnosis care that address the unique realities women face in recovery.
- [Young Adults](https://www.oceancoastrecovery.com/who-we-help/young-adults/): Age-matched addiction treatment for young adults in Costa Mesa, CA — detox and residential inpatient care built around developmental needs and real connection.
